analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 43.6, down from 48.8 five days ago, entering oversold territory. MACD histogram continues to worsen, from 3.5220 five days ago to -0.7134. Despite attempts to rebound after a string of 20 consecutive down days, evidence for a trend reversal is weak. Currently 11.3% above the 52-week low of $289.77.
